headline: Apple Cellular and Connectivity team member advertises a Munich Digital Mixed-Signal Design/Verification role
fact: An Apple Cellular and Connectivity team member publicly advertised a Digital Mixed-Signal Design/Verification Engineer role in Munich, one of four analog and mixed-signal design, validation, and verification openings in the hiring notice.

sources.title: Careers at Apple: Join us. Be you.
sources.summary: Public post dated October 21, 2022, by an Apple Cellular and Connectivity team member listing role 200436589 as a Digital Mixed-Signal Design/Verification Engineer opening in Munich.
